articles.title: Judge Puts Limits on Search for Noncitizen Voters
articles.summary: A judge limited a government search for noncitizen voters in nine states before the elections.

articles.title: Typhoon Champi Brings Storms and a Day Off in Taiwan
articles.summary: Typhoon Champi cancelled flights and closed schools in Taiwan as it passed nearby.

articles.title: Border Officers Check More Phones and Laptops
articles.summary: U.S. border searches of phones and laptops are up more than 32 percent this year.
